name: Custody router v1 (canonical)
summary: Pulls the input token from the signer, then runs 1..4 sequential swap_to hops across v8/v9 pools. Every failure reverts all hops.

functions.name: swap
functions.description: Multi-hop swap; intermediate hops pay the router and must be v9 pools, the last hop pays `recipient`.
functions.access: Anyone who approved the router for amount_in on the first input token. Only ever pulls from the caller.
